# gazebo-mcp (ag-gazebo-bridge)

> FastMCP 3.4 bridge from Gazebo robotics simulation to the fleet robotics mesh.  
> Wraps `gz` CLI for topic publish, model listing, and service calls; syncs simulation state to yahboom-mcp, unity3d-mcp, resonite-mcp, and freecad-mcp.

## Quick links
- [README](README.md) — full documentation
- [Install](docs/INSTALL_GAZEBO.md) — Gazebo + server setup
- [Fleet standards](https://github.com/sandraschi/mcp-central-docs)

## Tools (summary)
- `gz_topic_pub` — publish to a Gazebo topic
- `gz_topic_list` — list active topics
- `gz_sim_state` — list models in simulation
- `gz_service_call` — call a Gazebo service
- `sync_to_yahboom` — push robot command to physical Yahboom
- `sync_to_unity` — export scene to Unity 3D
- `sync_to_resonite` — spawn models in Resonite VR
- `sync_to_freecad` — export model to FreeCAD
- `fleet_sync_all` — broadcast to all fleet repos
- `fleet_status` — health check all connected repos

## Ports
| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| robotics-mcp | 10706 |
| yahboom-mcp | 10893 |
| unity3d-mcp | 10831 |
| resonite-mcp | 10979 |
| freecad-mcp | 10945 |

## Prompts
- `gazebo_help` — guidance for simulation control and fleet bridging
